_comment: Phase 2b golden: the useState reel as a PEER DISCUSSION (shorts/motion_themes.yaml). PEER_A has hit the bug, PEER_B has figured it out; both may ask. The running example is the counter from the source (count, setCount) rather than the reference's likes. Also the stub answer for the peer_discussion theme on useState material.
topic: Why does changing a plain variable not update the screen?
hook_question: Why does my counter stay stuck at zero?

shots.speech: Wait, why does my counter stay stuck at zero?

captions.text: Wait, why does my counter stay stuck at zero?
captions.speaker: PEER_A

shots.visual: Two desks: PEER_A's browser mock shows a counter button; each click fails and it stays 0.

shots.speech: Because your count lives in a plain variable.

captions.text: Because your count lives in a plain variable.
captions.speaker: PEER_B

shots.visual: Title card: series label, 'useState', the promise line, three icon tiles; PEER_B avatar beside it.

shots.speech: Here's my code. A plain count starts at zero, and each click adds one. Looks fine, right?

captions.text: Here's my code.
captions.speaker: PEER_A

captions.text: A plain count starts at zero, and each click adds one.
captions.speaker: PEER_A

captions.text: Looks fine, right?
captions.speaker: PEER_B

shots.visual: Code window Counter.jsx, two lines highlighted in turn.

shots.speech: But nothing tells React to run your component again. So the screen never changes. So the click does nothing?

captions.text: But nothing tells React to run your component again.
captions.speaker: PEER_B

captions.text: So the screen never changes.
captions.speaker: PEER_B

captions.text: So the click does nothing?
captions.speaker: PEER_A

shots.visual: Entity card <Counter /> above a system panel 'React: Idle'; the click's pulse stops at a broken connector.

shots.speech: And if it did run again? Then your count starts fresh, back at zero. The old variable is thrown away.

captions.text: And if it did run again?
captions.speaker: PEER_A

captions.text: Then your count starts fresh, back at zero.
captions.speaker: PEER_B

captions.text: The old variable is thrown away.
captions.speaker: PEER_B

shots.visual: A render sweep passes the entity card; the old count tile falls away and a new one reads 0.

shots.speech: So how do I fix it? With use State. React keeps your count in its own memory, across every render.

captions.text: So how do I fix it?
captions.speaker: PEER_A

captions.text: With useState.
captions.speaker: PEER_B

captions.text: React keeps your count in its own memory, across every render.
captions.speaker: PEER_B

shots.visual: System panel 'React' now holding a 'count' slot; a pulse travels up the connector to the entity card.

shots.speech: Call set Count, and React updates that memory. Then it runs your component again with the new value. And the screen catches up.

captions.text: Call setCount, and React updates that memory.
captions.speaker: PEER_B

captions.text: Then it runs your component again with the new value.
captions.speaker: PEER_B

captions.text: And the screen catches up.
captions.speaker: PEER_A

shots.visual: Trigger chip setCount(1) pulses to the system panel; the slot goes 0 to 1; the entity card re-renders showing 1.

shots.speech: In code, use State of zero gives you the count and its setter.

captions.text: In code, useState(0) gives you the count and its setter.
captions.speaker: PEER_B

shots.visual: Code map card: count -> memory icon 'the current value'; setCount -> bolt icon 'updates it and re-renders'.

shots.speech: Now every click counts, and the number keeps climbing.

captions.text: Now every click counts, and the number keeps climbing.
captions.speaker: PEER_A

shots.visual: The hook's browser mock again: each click succeeds and the counter climbs 1, 2, 3; status pill 'It works'.

shots.speech: Remember: re-renders reset plain variables. use State keeps the value. And the setter updates it and re-renders.

captions.text: Remember: re-renders reset plain variables.
captions.speaker: PEER_B

captions.text: useState keeps the value.
captions.speaker: PEER_B

captions.text: And the setter updates it and re-renders.
captions.speaker: PEER_B

shots.visual: Takeaway list: three rows with the refresh, memory and bolt icons.

shots.speech: Follow for more, one idea at a time.

captions.text: Follow for more, one idea at a time.
captions.speaker: PEER_A

shots.visual: End card: Up next, Follow button, series chips.
